# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities using this repository's **Security → Report a vulnerability** entry (GitHub private vulnerability reporting). Do not open a public issue containing exploit details or personal financial information. If private reporting is unavailable, open an issue containing only a request to enable it, with no vulnerability details.

Include the affected version, platform, expected security boundary and a minimal reproduction using fictional data. Never attach real ledgers, screenshots of holdings, backups, pairing secrets, tokens, device identifiers or unrestricted diagnostic logs.

This is a personal project with no guaranteed response time. The latest source release is the supported version. See [the security architecture](../Docs/SECURITY.md) for current boundaries and limitations.
